summary: Gone Tomorrow is a Lee Child novel and the thirteenth book in his Jack Reacher series. The note gives its publication dates in the United Kingdom and the United States and notes that it is narrated in the first person.
one_line: Gone Tomorrow is the thirteenth Jack Reacher novel by Lee Child, published in 2009.
key_facts: Gone Tomorrow is the thirteenth book in the Jack Reacher series.
Gone Tomorrow was written by Lee Child.
Gone Tomorrow was published on 23 April 2009 in the United Kingdom.
Gone Tomorrow was published on 19 May 2009 in the USA.
Gone Tomorrow is written in the first person.
